description: Having a moment of lightness here at the Berlin stop of the international tour for the new book. This month marks month #4 on the road doing podcasts, national media and book events. Thank so VERY much to EACH and every one of my beloved readers for making “The Wealth Money Can’t Buy” #1 in 11 countries, so far. This book is transforming so many human loves. Love, Robin
